concept.hr: FTL, blokovi za brisanje, pojačanje pisanja, TRIM i trošenje
concept.en: FTL, erase blocks, write amplification, TRIM and wear

summary.hr: Piši i prepisuj logičke blokove: FTL ih stavlja na nove stranice, skupljanje smeća kopira valjane i briše blokove, a TRIM štedi kopiranje.
summary.en: Write and overwrite logical blocks: the FTL puts them on new pages, garbage collection copies valid pages and erases blocks, and TRIM saves copies.
